newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah stable amid sufficient liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah stable amid sufficient liquidity.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was stable against the dollar in slow early trading on Tuesday amid sufficient liquidity supply, dealers said.
One local bank dealer said trading remained slow, with rates trapped in a very narrow range. Swaps were stable too.
Spot rupiah was at 2,428.50/28.75 at 0225 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,427.5/28.5. Tomorrow and today rupiah were at 2,428.10/28.45 and 2,427.75/28.00, respectively.
The rupiah has been traded between 2,427 and 2,429 since last week, making small to factor in average daily swap prices of about 0.3 points, dealers said.
The local bank dealer said this may suggest that capital inflows seemed to continue which capped the dollar from any rise and made the dollar top heavy at the 2,430 level.
Dealers said inflows were also seen in the stock market, with the index breaking the 700-point barrier on Monday.
They said liquidity supply was sufficient. Overnight money was traded at around 11.0/12.0 percent.
Overnight swap was at 0.35/0.40 and tom/next at 0.30/0.34.
One-month swaps were at 13.25/14.00, two at 26.25/26.75, three at 39.5/40.5 and six at 80.0/82.0 points.
Dealers said fears of a swap squeeze like in Thailand continued to linger over the forward market, forcing foreigners to maintain long forward positions.
The central bank raised its intervention band by one point to 2,422/2,614 and its conversion band also by one point to 2,422/2,470 on Monday.
